title: The Missing Reel
subtitle: Polebrook Walk
welcome_text: [[c:A mystery walk around Polebrook, a quiet village that found itself next to a busy American bomber base in the Second World War.]]
start_text: [[c:Start at the Kings Arms on Kings Arms Lane.]]

coins.explain: [[c:You have a purse of 5 coins for the whole walk. Hints are free. Showing an answer costs coins.]]

layers.label: Mystery story
layers.description: [[c:The story and the puzzles. Switch it off for a history-only walk.]]

route.name: Lutton Road, towards the old airfield
route.label: Towards the airfield

story: [[c:Polebrook, summer 1943. The airfield just outside the village is home to the 351st Bomb Group of the US Army Air Forces, and a film crew is making a picture about the airmen.]]
[[c:A reel of film has gone missing from the crew's van parked in the village. It holds shots of the airfield that must not fall into the wrong hands.]]
[[c:Four people were nearby: Peggy Ward, a Land Girl; Sergeant Hank Miller, a young American airman; Arthur Gibbs, the pub landlord; and Mr Leonard Pryce, a visiting salesman. Find the reel.]]

start_page.title: Getting to the start
start_page.intro: [[c:The walk starts and finishes at the Kings Arms.]]
parking: [[c:Parking: please park considerately on the village streets, or ask at the pub. If you're driving, park first and then open the walk.]]
start_page.support: [[c:Support the village: have a drink at the Kings Arms before or after your walk. The walk takes about 45 minutes to 1 hour 15.]]
